entries.text: TPC-DS OBT queries return the TPC-DS result. 37 queries were rewritten as one-table SQL (grain, correlated subqueries, customer-current attributes, return-side joins, the Q14 second part and Q24), Q46, Q64 and Q68 are served, and Q8, Q54 and Q84 join the inventory queries as recorded exclusions, so the catalog serves 90 of 99 queries. `make tpcds-obt-equivalence` compares every served query with TPC-DS at SF0.01 and SF1; no query is recorded as divergent at either scale. Q2 builds its calendar from the TPC-DS date table's fixed week and year boundaries instead of the sales rows, so it matches at every scale factor.
